chapters.title: Together
chapters.subtitle: Where every turn felt like home

scenes.title: The Open Road
scenes.subtitle: Mountain curves & motorcycle hums
content: Mountain roads slowly become city roads.
The Duke 390 leans through every curve as the cold wind cuts across our jackets.
No maps needed. Just the sound of the engine and the pressure of your hands holding tight.

scenes.title: Kochi Airport Departures
scenes.subtitle: The sound of engine cutoff
content: Signs begin pointing toward Kochi Airport.
The bike enters the departures line.

scenes.title: Runway Departure
scenes.subtitle: Flight Kochi → Udaipur
content: The bike disappears. A plane replaces it.
Looking out the window as the ground shrinks away, holding on to every word spoken before boarding.

scenes.title: Reunion Walks
scenes.subtitle: Stealing moments across cities
content: Quiet walks, shared coffee, and counting down the hours before the next flight back.
Flights were no longer just vacations. They had become our lifelines.

scenes.title: Midnight Lifelines
scenes.subtitle: Screen glows & late night calls
content: Airports now feel familiar, almost like second homes.
Yet through late-night calls, inside jokes, and daily traditions...
